cross_cultural.reason: Level 2: the sustainability report lists specific current internal practices, namely Employee Resource Groups (E1) and an LGBTQ+ benefits guide (E2). It gives no membership numbers, participant figures or other reach indicators, so the score cannot reach level 3. The workforce demographics (E3) and the 10-K's non-discrimination policy and inclusion training language (E4) are disclosure and boilerplate only, so they support level 1 at most and do not raise the score.

ai.notes: Score source: 10-K + sustainability report. The 10-K human capital section refers to the Corporate Responsibility Report for more detail and gives only policy-level inclusion language. The report adds ERGs and an LGBTQ+ benefits guide without figures. The Foundation's 'Community Enrichment & Safety' giving pillar mentions fostering inclusion and promoting diversity, but no specific program or amount is tied to it, so it was not scored. A low-and-moderate-income (LMI) energy-efficiency program appears in the NY CIP savings table. It serves low-income customers rather than removing cultural, language or background barriers, so it was conservatively excluded from this theme. The report says the 'Other' demographic category includes Native American or Alaska Native, Native Hawaiian or Pacific Islander, and Two or More Races. The demographic figures are disclosure only.
